comment: M02 golden-slice faction read. A joined player waits on the gallery while posed views frame the guards placed from the start: the two seated Clerks in the guard room and the three ward guards around the machine and the frame. Check black armour, red visors, armbands and optics against the ward's enamel, steel and fixture pools at room distance; art review, not combat evidence.
